page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin (one at the top, one level with "Hic enim ridiculum"). Below the text: signature "H 5" at left and catchword "po:" at right. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: se fuit, etsi per alium mora erat,
quo minus id fieret, aut quod
quam ex vulnere, ab illo illa-
bat. Ut si hoc casu occidere
parato, ut vel ad nutum cujusvis

page.notes: The marginal note "1.39. D. de Reg. jur." is printed as "1.39. D." / "de Reg." / "jur." across three lines and is shown here as one note. The note "Tolet. Infruct. Sacerd. 1.5, c.6." is printed as "Tolet.In-/ftruct./Sacerd./1.5, c.6." and is shown here as one note. Long s and the "ct" ligature were read as plain s and ct. The word "eû" is printed with a diacritic over the u and is copied as printed. Some digits in the margin notes are small and may be misread (e.g. "1.39" and "1.5").
